message.omnica.out_of_range: Target Nexus Node is out of range (%s blocks)!
gui.omnica.config.title: OMNICA Configuration
gui.omnica.config.max_distance.tooltip: Maximum range between two connected Nexus Nodes (default 32 blocks).
gui.omnica.config.transfer_interval.tool: How often the network transfers items between containers. Lower = faster, Higher = ultra-efficient (default 8 ticks / 0.4s).
gui.omnica.config.items_per_transfer.too: Maximum quantity of items moved per transfer pulse (default 64).
gui.omnica.config.render_beams.tooltip: Display radiant amethyst laser lines between linked nodes.
gui.omnica.config.render_items.tooltip: Show visual items physically floating and traveling through the air along tethers.
gui.omnica.config.sounds.tooltip: Play resonant amethyst chimes and audio cues during item transfers.
